summary: Tested visitor access feature - visitors can browse all content but interaction points show SignUpModal. Fixed a bug in MessagesPage where loading state was never set to false for unauthenticated users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visitor access feature is working correctly. All browsing features work for visitors. Interaction points (favorite, message, post gig, booking request) show SignUpModal with action-specific messages. Fixed MessagesPage loading state bug.

passed: Visitors can view Auditions page and see video content
Visitors can view user profiles by clicking on usernames
Visitors can access the Map page and see user locations (7 users found)
Visitors can access the Gigs page and browse gigs (36 gigs found)
Clicking favorite/star button on Auditions shows SignUpModal with 'save favorites' message
Clicking Message button on profiles shows SignUpModal with 'send messages to other users' message
Clicking Post a Gig button shows SignUpModal with 'apply to gigs' message
My Posts button is hidden for visitors on Gigs page
Help Center shows login prompt: 'Please log in to submit a support ticket'
Messages page shows SignUpModal for visitors (after fix)
Venue Calendar shows 'Sign in to request a booking' link for visitors
not_fully_tested: Gig contact info hidden for visitors - tested gigs didn't have contact info set, but code review confirms 'Sign up to view contact info' button is shown when contact info exists
Venue Calendar SignUpModal - the 'Sign in to request a booking' link is visible but clicking it didn't show the modal in tests (may be a timing issue or the venue profile was invalid)

bugs_fixed.issue: Loading state was never set to false for unauthenticated users, causing the page to show 'Loading...' forever instead of the SignUpModal
bugs_fixed.fix: Added setLoading(false) when user is not authenticated
